coverage.US: 2026 novel drug approvals (FDA list) and upcoming PDUFA dates.
coverage.EU: All 2026 European Commission authorisations and CHMP positive opinions for new medicines, from EMA's official medicines data (generics and hybrid copies of old substances excluded). Includes the date of the CHMP opinion and of the Commission decision.
coverage.CA: All submissions under review (with month accepted, as of 30 Sep 2026). 2026 approvals loaded for ingredients A–E only so far.
coverage.CH: 2026 authorisations of medicines with new active substances.
coverage.JP: 2026 approvals: PMDA's official list (to February 2026) plus later approvals compiled by KEGG from Japanese regulatory records.
coverage.SG: 2026 new drug approvals (NDA-1 and NDA-2). HSA does not list indications.
coverage.UK: 2026 MHRA licences (fortnightly PDF lists) for drugs tracked elsewhere in this register, plus selected new active substances. MHRA's lists don't flag new substances, so this isn't a complete list of UK new medicines.

coverage.TW: 2026 Taiwan FDA drug licences (open data) for drugs tracked elsewhere, plus selected new active substances. Licence dates; not a complete list of Taiwan new medicines.
coverage.BR: 2026 ANVISA registrations (open data) for drugs tracked elsewhere, plus selected new active substances. Dates are when the registration process was completed; not a complete list of Brazil new medicines.
